description: This file defines the Administrator class and related components for managing IPC proxies, stubs, and message handling within the Thunder namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures for IPC communication, proxy/stub registration, and resource management.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages IPC proxies, stubs, and message dispatching, including registration, resource management, and cleanup.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job for IPC message handling, including setting message and channel, and invoking messages.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server implementations with submit and revoke methods.

classes.name: InvokeServer
classes.description: Implements IIPCServer, manages message dispatching using a thread pool.

classes.name: InvokeServerType
classes.description: Template class for a thread pool-based IPC server with configurable thread counts and message slots.

methods.name: RegisterInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface proxy with the IPC system.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy instance for a given channel and implementation ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel and implementation ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a proxy is valid for a given channel, implementation, and interface ID.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for a proxy.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for a proxy or releases a proxy.
